question: Which of the following combinations of athletics winners at the 2025 National Games is entirely correct?

options.text: Parul Chaudhary - 3000m steeplechase; Jyothi Yarraji - 100m hurdles
Lovlina - 100m hurdles; Amoj Jacob - Shot Put

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.
